name: docker
description: Manage Docker containers, images, and compose stacks. List, start, stop, build, and inspect containers.

target.description: Container name/ID, image name, or compose file path

manual.overview: Use to inspect, run, stop, and manage Docker containers and images when debugging services, running builds, or orchestrating local dev environments.

examples.description: Run a container with env vars in detached mode
Bring up a compose stack from a file

tips: Use ps before stop/rm to confirm container names and IDs
Include -d in run args for detached backgrounds
compose_up target can be directory (uses docker-compose.yml) or explicit file path
edge_cases: Docker daemon must be running; failures often mean Docker isn't started
stop/rm on wrong target can take down production containers—verify first
